end.parentNote: Asha practised describing growing patterns and connecting them to algebraic rules. Reyansh successfully followed substitution in 2n + 2 and calculated 3 × 30 + 2 by showing the multiplication and addition steps. In 6n + 4 = 200, they were unsure what the non-whole result meant; this was not corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen: false). At home, practise checking whether a chosen value of n makes a rule produce the target number, using a few short examples.
